system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: The default static prefix contains a smallNOOAsystem prompt (about 1k characters), the active strategy instructions (about 2.5k characters for CodeAct), an execution-context block showing imported types and libraries
system_prompt_style.note: Assembled from context blocks: static blocks plus dynamic blocks re-rendered every turn. Evidence is the paper only; the repo code was not opened.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Method arguments, the live agent asself , and the agent’s environment (imports, methods, and constants defined in the agent’s source file) are injected as locals
env_context_strategy.note: The model explores live objects via doc()/pprint in a REPL. The dynamic context also renders pprint(self) previews. BenchAgent adds tree-sitter repository navigation tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Long histories can be collapsed into summary events, akin to MemGPT’s context management [43]
context_compaction.note: Bounded previews truncate observations and arguments (pass by reference). The events.collapse API performs summarization. The repo has src/nooa/agents/summarization.py. Which of these is on by default is not stated.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Media arguments – images, audio, video, and files – are rendered as native multimodal content blocks rather than text
observation_format.note: Events are rendered as typed Python reprs in XML-like tags (text). Captured images are passed as multimodal content.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: The model may callexecute_python(...) to compute, inspect internal agent state, call helpers, or invoke other generation methods
tool_call_format.note: CodeAct is the default strategy: Python code is sent through an execute_python tool call. PredictStrategy returns a typed value in a single LLM call instead.

tool_count.evidence_quote: the model must choose between continuing computation with execute_python(...) or terminating the method with return_result(...)
tool_count.note: Default CodeAct exposes execute_python and return_result. Agent methods are callable from inside code, not as separate schemas. The seven memory tools are added when memory is installed.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Cells can contain loops, conditionals, library calls, async operations, helper calls, and subagent invocations.
edit_primitive.note: The core framework has no dedicated edit tool; edits are made through Python code. BenchAgent has shell file-editing tools, but their primitive is unreported.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: Python methods and type annotations supply the callable interfaces, reducing the need to write separate tool-schema definitions.
tool_schema_source.note: The repo includes an MCP client at src/nooa/mcp/client.py.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: the harness records the observation, re-renders the updated state, and repeats until the model callsreturn_result(...) with a value that is type validated.
loop_primitives.note: On return, a type-validation failure feeds an error back to the model, giving a repair loop. The event manager is a typed event log.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Dynamic blocks hold information whose value changes as the program runs, such as aTODO listor selected relevant fields onself .
planning_granularity.note: The todo list is a developer or BenchAgent feature, not a core default.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The cell can inspect objects withdoc(obj) , print bounded previews with pprint() , call deterministic helpers, await generation methods, spawn subagents
multi_agent_topology.note: The default is a single agent. The model can spawn subagents from code (orchestrator_workers is reachable).

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: it can define a new@strategy -decorated function with an ellipsis body and fan it out over a batch with asyncio.gather , creating parallel subagent calls in ordinary Python.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Durable state is stored on the agent object, rather than only in conversation history.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The entire store is one SQLite file that can be inspected directly; vector indexes are derived from it and interchangeable.
long_term_memory.note: Memory is optional (nooa-memory, installed via MemoryManager.install). Skills are available per examples/quickstart/10_skills.py. The core default has no long-term memory.

self_verification.evidence_quote: When the model returns a result, the harness validates it against the return annotation.
self_verification.note: This is closer to type/contract validation than to tests; closest value chosen. CyberGym uses a separate LLM judge, but only in that example.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If the result is invalid, the harness sends the model an error message describing the failure, and the loop continues.
retry_policy.note: Validation retries happen at step level, not whole-task. Predict runs a local retry loop on validation failure.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: repeats until the model callsreturn_result(...) with a value that is type validated.
termination_condition.note: No step or cost caps are reported in the evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: This three-region layout is designed to maximize KV-cache reuse across turns
cost_controls.note: Per-method model override lets a small model serve classification (Sec. 3.1).

timeouts.note: The ARC sandbox example has a hard cell timeout, but only in that example.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: NOOAexecutes model-written code in the agent’s own process.
execution_isolation.note: An optional sandbox exists at src/nooa/runtime/sandbox; OpenShell is recommended.

network_policy.evidence_quote: LLM-generated code may take dangerous or unwanted actions, including sending private data to uncontrolled locations

permission_model.evidence_quote: NOOA validates generated code (AST checks) and applies module deny-lists before execution.

tracing.note: Traces are on by default when the viewer runs.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Dangerous or loop-breaking APIs such aseval , exec , compile , input , and blocking event-loop calls are rejected with specific errors.

target_domain.evidence_quote: NOOAtakes a simpler approach: an agent is a Python object.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Choose from supported hosted or local [LiteLLM-supported](https://docs.litellm.ai/) model

primary_artifact.note: The pinned tag postdates the paper (2026-07-22).
